ars_sable.command.miniature.not_found: No miniature sublevel is stored with that id.
ars_sable.glyph_desc.glyph_miniaturize: Converts a targeted sublevel into an item that can be placed in the world.
ars_sable.glyph_desc.glyph_sublevel: Allows glyphs to target the simulated level instead of the block or entity that was hit. This allows for other block-moving glyphs like Pull or Knockback to move entire the simulated level around.
ars_sable.miniaturize.missing: This miniature sublevel no longer exists.
